name: Sibutramine
summary: Sibutramine, formerly sold under the brand name Meridia among others, is an appetite suppressant which has been discontinued in many countries. Amphetamine derivate, psychostimulant drug. It works as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI) similar to certain antidepressants. Until 2010, it was widely marketed and prescribed as an adjunct in the treatment of obesity along with diet and exercise.

pharmacology.text: Sibutramine is a serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) that, in humans, reduces the reuptake of norepinephrine (by ~73%), serotonin (by ~54%), and dopamine (by ~16%), thereby increasing the levels of these substances in synaptic clefts and helping enhance satiety; the serotonergic action, in particular, is thought to influence appetite.

uses.text: Sibutramine, formerly sold under the brand name Meridia among others, is an appetite suppressant which has been discontinued in many countries. Until 2010, it was widely marketed and prescribed as an adjunct in the treatment of obesity along with diet and exercise.

sideEffects.text: A higher number of cardiovascular events has been observed in people taking sibutramine versus control (11.4% vs. 10.0%). In 2010, the FDA noted the concerns that sibutramine increases the risk of heart attacks and strokes in patients with a history of cardiovascular disease.

summaryZh: 西布曲明，化學名N-(1-(1-(4-氯苯基)環丁基)-3-甲基丁基)-N,N-二甲胺，化學式C17H26ClN，是一種作用於中樞神經系統的食慾抑制劑，其化學結構與安非他命有點關連，但作用機理不同。它在醫學上可作為一種口服的減肥藥，通常使用鹽酸西布曲明生產藥品。變種有氯代西布曲明及氯代西戊曲明。
summaryZhHans: 西布曲明，化学名N-(1-(1-(4-氯苯基)环丁基)-3-甲基丁基)-N,N-二甲胺，化学式C17H26ClN，是一种作用于中枢神经系统的食欲抑制剂，其化学结构与安非他命有点关连，但作用机理不同。它在医学上可作为一种口服的减肥药，通常使用盐酸西布曲明生产药品。变种有氯代西布曲明及氯代西戊曲明。

fact.en: Sibutramine was first developed as an antidepressant, but researchers noticed that it made people lose weight, so it was turned into an obesity drug instead. After its withdrawal it kept turning up as a hidden ingredient in some so-called herbal slimming products.
fact.zh: 西布曲明最初是當作抗憂鬱藥開發的，研究人員發現它會讓人體重下降，於是改作為減肥藥。它下市後，仍不斷在一些號稱天然草本的減肥產品中被驗出是隱藏成分。
fact.zhHans: 西布曲明最初是当作抗忧郁药开发的，研究人员发现它会让人体重下降，于是改作为减肥药。它下市后，仍不断在一些号称天然草本的减肥产品中被验出是隐藏成分。
